purpose: Epoch snapshot storage infrastructure: types, backend interface, factory type, and in-memory reference implementation. Provides the persistence seam for pre-apply MLS state snapshots used by the concurrent-commit rollback path.

public_api.name: EpochSnapshot
public_api.signature: interface EpochSnapshot { groupId: Uint8Array; epoch: bigint; state: SerializedClientState; appliedCommit?: { eventId: string; createdAt: number; contentHash: Uint8Array }; }
public_api.description: Immutable snapshot of group MLS state at a given epoch, optionally annotated with the commit event that caused the transition.

public_api.name: EpochSnapshotStoreBackend
public_api.signature: interface EpochSnapshotStoreBackend { get(groupIdHex: string, epoch: bigint): Promise<EpochSnapshot | null>; set(groupIdHex: string, epoch: bigint, snapshot: EpochSnapshot): Promise<void>; prune(groupIdHex: string, keepAboveEpoch: bigint): Promise<void>; clear(groupIdHex: string): Promise<void>; }
public_api.description: Storage backend contract for epoch snapshots. Implementations may be in-memory or persistent.

public_api.name: EpochSnapshotStoreFactory
public_api.description: Factory function that creates a backend scoped to a given group ID.

public_api.name: InMemoryEpochSnapshotStore
public_api.description: In-memory reference implementation of EpochSnapshotStoreBackend using a Map. Exported from src/extra/.

dependencies_forbidden: src/client/ (any module except via type imports from epoch-snapshot.ts itself)
external_ports: EpochSnapshotStoreBackend — injected into MarmotGroup via MarmotGroupOptions.snapshots
